pages.mainText: About GF We are a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, we deliver differentiated, power‑efficient and high‑performance solutions for automotive, aerospace and defense, data center, smart mobile devices, internet of things and other high‑growth markets. We shape what’s essential What makes our world smarter, faster, safer and more connected? What lets you feel secure, whether you’re at home or on the move? Essential chips do. Essential chips are the foundation of modern life, and we make them. GF is a differentiated technology partner, combining R&D, IP, design, custom silicon and advanced manufacturing across a flexible global footprint. Built on deep partnerships with customers, governments and ecosystem collaborators, we enable what matters most. The video could not be loaded. Mission, vision & values We innovate and partner with our customers to deliver solutions for humanity. We manufacture semiconductors around the globe. We are changing the industry that is changing the world. Create We innovate beyond what is possible today, differentiate our technology to enable customer success, bring a passion for problem-solving and create value for our customers and for our shareholders. Embrace We believe diversity is a competitive advantage, that the best ideas come from being inclusive, that we act with a shared sense of purpose and that we respect everyone. Partner We collaborate across all borders and boundaries, strive for win-win outcomes, build trust as the basis of every relationship and ensure our customers can count on us to deliver on our commitment. Deliver We work effectively, efficiently and decisively, focus on outcomes and are accountable for results, celebrate and reward success and recognize that nothing matters without safety. Milestones in our history 2009 2010 & 2015 2013 2018 2021 2022–2026 2009 GlobalFoundries is founded GlobalFoundries is formed as a joint venture between Mubadala and AMD to address growing global demand for advanced semiconductors. From the outset, we are established with a mission to deliver differentiated manufacturing and technology capabilities at global scale. 2010 & 2015 Expanding global manufacturing scale We accelerate our global footprint through the acquisition of Chartered Semiconductor in Singapore in 2010 and IBM’s microelectronics business in 2015, including fabs and intellectual property. These moves establish GF as a scaled foundry with deep capabilities across RF, silicon photonics and advanced manufacturing. 2013 Advanced manufacturing takes shape in the U.S. Construction begins on our fab in Malta, New York, the first advanced foundry built in the U.S. in decades. The site becomes a cornerstone of our advanced manufacturing strategy, delivering initial silicon “first time right” as production ramps. 2018 Differentiation through FDX™ FD-SOI & RF leadership We introduce our FDX™ FD-SOI platform and become the world’s leading RF-SOI foundry. This period reflects a strategic pivot toward differentiated, feature‑rich technologies optimized for power efficiency, connectivity and critical end markets. 2021 GlobalFoundries becomes a public company We complete our initial public offering, listing our shares on Nasdaq under the symbol GFS. The IPO marks a new chapter, increasing visibility and supporting long‑term investment in manufacturing scale and differentiated technology leadership. 2022–2026 Expanding capabilities & acquisitions Following our IPO, we accelerate growth through targeted acquisitions and technology agreements—Tagore Technology, MIPS, Advanced Micro Foundry, InfiniLink and Synopsys’ ARC Processor IP business—strengthening our leadership in power, silicon photonics, optical connectivity and processor IP to advance AI data center solutions. Innovation is at the heart of everything we do Our approach to innovation is built on partnership. We work closely with customers, universities, governments and industry collaborators to accelerate technology development and strengthen the global semiconductor supply chain. GF Labs As our strategic growth engine, GF Labs creates and incubates the disruptive technologies that strengthen our leadership today and open entirely new markets tomorrow. Learn more: GF Labs University partnerships We are the partner of choice for universities advancing real-world semiconductor innovation. We work side–by–side with leading academic institutions to turn breakthrough research into industry-ready outcomes and prepare the next generation of talent. Learn more: University partnerships “Fostering semiconductor innovation is critical to delivering a differentiated technology portfolio that will continue to fuel emerging markets. Our focus is on making sure we’re always developing the latest technologies that provide meaningful differentiation for our customers, not just in the near-term, but far into the next decade.” Gregg Bartlett, Chief Technology Officer See how we shape what’s essential We are a global semiconductor partner and technology innovator. With a footprint spanning four continents, we deliver manufacturing optionality and supply chain resilience to customers worldwide. Our differentiated portfolio of process technologies, R&D, government and university partnerships powers the world’s most critical industries, from automotive and smart devices to IoT, data center and Physical AI. What sets us apart is our commitment to delivering trusted, essential chips through deep customer co-innovation and partnerships. We’re redefining what’s possible by providing practical solutions that drive real-world impact, placing us at the heart of the global semiconductor ecosystem. jsonLdDescriptions: We are committed to being a responsible employer, strong corporate citizen and positive force in the communities our employees call home.
pages.mainText: Community impact We are committed to being a responsible employer, strong corporate citizen and positive force in the communities our employees call home. Our global community impact efforts are anchored by GlobalGives, our giving and volunteer platform, which brings together corporate philanthropy, employee giving, volunteerism and a company match under one unified framework. We are dedicated to making an impact As a major employer in regions around the world, we contribute to local economies, strengthen high‑tech clusters and work closely with community partners to help meet real needs, from disaster relief and humanitarian response to education, workforce development and local nonprofit support. Our impact is rooted in longstanding programs and powered by our global team, united by a shared commitment to improving lives where we live and work. $6M+ donated, driven by GF and employee giving in 2025 1,200+ nonprofits supported, powered by GF corporate giving and employee matching in 2025 10,900+ volunteer hours contributed by GF employees across our global communities in 2025 Stillwater community grants Workforce & community investments Global disaster relief Stillwater community grants Each year, the GF–Town of Stillwater Foundation and the Town of Stillwater partner to support local organizations through an annual community grants program. Applications for the 2026 cycle are now open, offering funding for initiatives that advance education, arts, recreation, health, safety and overall well‑being for Stillwater residents. Since 2013, the foundation has invested more than $630,000 in community organizations, helping deliver meaningful, locally driven impact year after year. Workforce & community investments GF’s workforce and community investments are centered on strengthening the broader semiconductor ecosystem and the regions where GF operates. Areas of investment include deep collaboration with colleges and universities, partnerships with regional museums, and workforce programs such as pre-apprenticeship and pre-employment training to support the communities where we operate. Global disaster relief & humanitarian response Through GlobalGives, we rapidly mobilize support across the world when disasters strike — from flooding in Germany and Iowa, to landslides in India, earthquakes in Taiwan and tornado outbreaks across the U.S. We have backed multiple global disaster‑relief campaigns, contributing tens of thousands of dollars to provide emergency shelter, food, medical care and recovery assistance where it was needed most. Registered apprenticeship program Our apprenticeship program — the first registered semiconductor apprenticeship in the U.S. — supports community impact by creating pathways into stable, well‑paying careers in advanced manufacturing. Since launching in 2021, the program has expanded, including adding a new trade to further develop and professionalize the technician career pathway. Through hands‑on training, education partnerships and mentorship, the program expands access to technical careers, strengthens local talent pipelines and helps residents build long‑term opportunities in the regions where we operate. STEM at GF We are invested in building the semiconductor workforce of tomorrow, and that starts with inspiring interest in STEM today. Through STEM at GF, we connect students, educators and community partners with real engineers, real technology and real pathways into the semiconductor industry. Our approach spans the full pipeline, from K–12 classroom visits and career exploration events, to educator resources and curriculum support, to immersive programs like our High School Job Shadow Program that bring students on site for hands-on learning. Our trained STEM ambassadors lead structured outreach across our global communities, reaching thousands of students each year. We also equip educators to bring semiconductor learning into their own classrooms. Through partnerships like our work with the New York State Department of Labor’s Teacher Academy, we train teachers to talk about STEM and GF’s role in it, extending our reach far beyond what our teams could do alone. These efforts are strengthened by partnerships with FIRST Robotics, Girls Inc., regional school districts, children’s museums and career and technical education organizations, expanding access to STEM learning and building the foundation for the future semiconductor workforce.

pages.mainText: Innovation At GF, innovation is purposeful, collaborative and grounded in real-world impact. We focus on advancing technologies that matter, delivering differentiated solutions that help customers solve complex challenges and bringing essential products to market. How we innovate Our innovation extends beyond research alone. It is embedded across our technology platforms, manufacturing capabilities and ecosystem partnerships. By combining deep technical expertise with close collaboration, we turn ideas into scalable, manufacturable solutions. We work closely with customers, industry collaborators, research institutes, universities and governments to accelerate technology development and strengthen the global semiconductor supply chain. GF Labs GF Labs is our central R&D organization, leading the development of differentiated process technologies in close partnership with research institutes, industry partners, universities and governments. GF Labs steers next-generation innovations into our production portfolio, ensuring research is manufacturable by design. Learn more: GF Labs University partnerships Our university partnership network connects more than 80 universities and over 100 professors to our technology roadmap. These partnerships support joint R&D, workforce development and a strong talent pipeline for our fabs across the U.S., Europe and Asia. Learn more: University partnerships GF Accelerate GF Accelerate is our venture investment program, backing early-stage founders building the next generation of essential semiconductor and deep-tech innovation. Through limited-partner commitments and direct collaborations with leading venture firms across the U.S., Europe and Singapore, we connect emerging companies to our manufacturing expertise and differentiated technology platforms. Learn more: GF Accelerate

Our approach to public policy engagement
jsonLdDescriptions: We work with governments, industry organizations and policy stakeholders to share perspectives on issues that impact semiconductor manufacturing.
pages.mainText: Public policy engagement Across our global footprint, we work with governments, industry organizations and policy stakeholders to share perspectives on issues that impact semiconductor manufacturing, technology leadership and economic security. Our engagement is grounded in transparency, responsibility and long-term value creation. Our global public policy engagement focuses on areas critical to secure, sustainable and resilient semiconductor manufacturing. Areas of focus: Advancing semiconductor manufacturing growth Manufacturing trusted and secure chips Investment in semiconductor manufacturing, innovation and research and development Resilient and responsible supply chains Environmental sustainability and combating climate change Workforce development, talent pipelines and inclusion and engagement Tax law and policies impacting semiconductor manufacturing Intellectual property protection and competitive markets Our approach to public policy engagement Our public policy activities are grounded in transparency, responsible governance and constructive collaboration. We engage with policymakers around the world to advance public policies that support secure, sustainable and resilient semiconductor manufacturing. We collaborate with trade associations, coalitions and other industry organizations where priorities align with our mission and values. Through these partnerships, we contribute expertise, perspective and advocacy to support policy objectives that strengthen the global semiconductor ecosystem. Governance & transparency Our public policy engagement is guided by our Worldwide Standards of Business Conduct and complies with all applicable laws and regulations. Our activities are overseen through established governance and accountability processes. In the U.S., we disclose lobbying activity as required by law and file reports on a quarterly basis in accordance with applicable regulations. These reports are available through the Senate’s Lobbying Disclosure Act Database. Outside the U.S., we comply with all relevant disclosure requirements for political engagement and lobbying activity. Globally, we do not make direct political contributions to political candidates. Additional information Access our Statement of Political & Public Policy Involvement for further details on our governance approach, disclosures and policy engagement practices. View statement (opens in a new tab)

pages.title: Risk & business continuity management | GlobalFoundries
pages.metaDescription: Our approach to risk and business continuity management supports resilient operations, secure supply chains and long-term value creation.
pages.ogDescription: Our approach to risk and business continuity management supports resilient operations, secure supply chains and long-term value creation.
jsonLdDescriptions: Our approach to risk and business continuity management supports resilient operations, secure supply chains and long-term value creation.
pages.mainText: Risk & business continuity management Our approach to risk and business continuity management supports resilient operations, secure supply chains and long-term value creation. Our approach We maintain a structured approach to enterprise risk management designed to identify, assess and manage risks that could impact our operations, people, customers or long-term strategy. Our approach emphasizes preparedness, accountability and resilience across our global footprint. Enterprise risk management Our enterprise risk management framework supports consistent identification and evaluation of key risks across the company. These risks are monitored and managed through established processes that align with our business strategy, compliance obligations and operational priorities. Risk considerations are integrated into decision-making across functions and regions to support stability and long-term performance. Business continuity & resilience Business continuity planning is a core component of how we prepare for and respond to potential disruptions. Our continuity planning focuses on protecting people, maintaining critical operations and minimizing impact to customers and stakeholders. We regularly review and update continuity plans to address evolving risks and operating conditions across our global manufacturing and support operations. Governance & oversight Oversight of risk and business continuity management is embedded within our broader governance and compliance structures. Senior leadership is responsible for ensuring alignment between risk management, business continuity planning and the company’s strategic objectives. This governance structure supports accountability, coordination and continuous improvement. Continuous monitoring & improvement We regularly evaluate and refine our risk and business continuity practices to reflect changes in the operating environment, regulatory landscape and global risk conditions. Ongoing monitoring and cross-functional collaboration help strengthen preparedness over time. Key focus areas Our risk and business continuity efforts focus on areas critical to operational resilience and long-term success, including: Operational resilience and manufacturing continuity Supply chain continuity and security Cybersecurity and digital risk readiness Regulatory and compliance risk management Health, safety and environmental risk mitigation

pages.mainText: Suppliers We are committed to building strong, collaborative relationships with our suppliers that are grounded in trust, transparency and aligned expectations. We value long‑term partnerships that support mutual success and reinforce the integrity of our global supply chain. Our achievements rely on solid, trustworthy relationships with our suppliers. We emphasize collaboration, innovation, quality and accountability, partnering closely with our suppliers to fulfill customer demands in a competitive international market. Our key supplier priorities: Conduct business with integrity and responsibility Ensure a consistent and dependable supply of products and services Promote and involve diverse suppliers whenever feasible Quick links Supply Chain Collaboration (SCC) portal Supplier Quality portal (opens in a new tab) Capital Equipment Procurement Document (CEPD) (opens in a new tab) Supplier relationships We work closely with our suppliers to support consistent performance, high quality and reliable delivery, while maintaining strong standards for safety and ethics. Clear communication and alignment on expectations help ensure suppliers are well prepared as our business evolves. By strengthening supplier engagement and accountability, we help foster innovation and maintain a resilient, dependable supply network that serves our customers around the world. All suppliers are expected to operate in accordance with GlobalFoundries’ Supplier Code of Conduct and applicable legal and ethical requirements. As a member of the Responsible Business Alliance (RBA), GlobalFoundries promotes responsible sourcing practices across its supply chain. Ethics & compliance We are committed to conducting business with integrity and encourage suppliers and their employees to speak up if they have a concern. Concerns may be reported through GlobalFoundries’ Ethics First Helpline, anonymously where permitted by applicable law. The helpline is available 24 hours a day, seven days a week, by phone at 1‑866‑345‑6885 (U.S.) or online at www.globalfoundries.ethicspoint.com, where direct dial numbers for other countries are available. We do not tolerate retaliation against anyone who raises a concern in good faith. GF Supplier Code of Conduct & handbook GF Supplier Code of Conduct We require all suppliers, along with their affiliates, contractors and subcontractors, to adhere to our Supplier Code of Conduct. This document establishes the standards necessary for conducting business responsibly, ethically and securely throughout our worldwide supply chain. It also addresses essential topics such as regulatory, audit and compliance obligations, including labor laws, trade controls and supplier audit requirements and supports a resilient and accountable global supply network. Read GF Supplier Code of Conduct GF Supplier handbook The GF Supplier handbook provides essential guidance for working with us. It outlines our expectations and key processes designed to support a clear, consistent and performance‑based supplier relationship. The handbook includes an overview of GF and our supplier teams, quality and sourcing requirements, supply and delivery obligations, business continuity strategies and supplier performance management processes. pages.mainText: Sustainability & responsibility We are committed to operating responsibly, minimizing environmental impact and supporting the long-term resilience of the essential technologies the world relies on. 2026 Sustainability Report highlights As we innovate and partner with customers to deliver differentiated technology solutions and shape what’s essential, we are committed to doing the right thing as a company. Every year, we publish a comprehensive report to share our efforts and progress. SBTi-validated climate target The Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) validated GF’s near-term target to cut absolute Scope 1 and 2 emissions 42% by 2030 from a 2021 baseline and to engage suppliers representing 76% of our Scope 3 upstream emissions from purchased goods, services and capital goods to set science-based targets of their own by 2030 Lowest injury rates in company history With a total recordable incident rate (TRIR) of 0.07 and a lost time incident rate (LTIR) of 0.05, GF surpassed its 2025 safety goals — continuing our Journey to Zero and setting a new safety benchmark across all our global fabs. Recognized among net-zero leaders GF was named to Forbes’ Net Zero Leaders, Newsweek’s America’s Greenest Companies and USA Today’s America’s Climate Leaders — and earned CDP scores of “B” for Climate Change and “A−” for Water Security. Powering AI efficiently Our differentiated technologies — including Silicon Photonics and new gallium nitride (GaN) power solutions — deliver high-efficiency data and power for AI data centers, electric vehicles and renewable energy, building sustainability into the solutions we make. Top-tier sustainability ratings Independent raters affirm our progress: a Sustainalytics “Low Risk” rating, an ISS “Prime” rating in the top decile, and an S&P Corporate Sustainability Assessment placing GF in the top 10% of the semiconductor industry. A global lighthouse for smart manufacturing The World Economic Forum named GF’s Singapore fab to its Global Lighthouse Network, recognizing our use of AI, IoT and advanced analytics to drive productivity, sustainability and workforce development. Read the 2026 Sustainability Report Read full report (opens in a new tab) Read summary (opens in a new tab) Sustainability at GF Sustainability is integral to how we manufacture at scale, partner with customers and support the markets and communities that depend on reliable, secure semiconductor supply. Guided by our Journey to Zero, we focus on measurable progress—reducing emissions, improving resource efficiency and advancing responsible manufacturing—while enabling our customers to meet their own sustainability and regulatory goals. Our technology solutions help enable a more sustainable, energy-efficient and healthier world by supporting the power efficient, secure and reliable electronics essential to modern life. Pillars of sustainability Environmental sustainability & our Journey to Zero Environmental sustainability is foundational to how we operate and innovate. Journey to Zero guides our long-term environmental strategy across energy, water and emissions Commitment to achieve net zero Scope 1 and 2 greenhouse gas emissions by 2050, with an interim goal to reduce emissions 42% by 2030 (from a 2021 baseline) Continuous improvements in energy efficiency, water stewardship and emissions reduction across global manufacturing operations Ongoing investments in environmental programs that strengthen sustainability performance and support more resilient tech ecosystems Our differentiated semiconductor technologies support customer innovation in energy efficient, low power electronics that contribute to broader environmental progress Responsible manufacturing & operations Sustainability is embedded in how we manufacture at scale. Rigorous operational frameworks and ISO-certified management systems (including EHS) underpin responsible, efficient manufacturing Resource-efficient processes designed to deliver consistent quality, safety and reliability at scale Strong environmental, health and safety standards embedded across global operations Disciplined operational controls that support reliable production for automotive, industrial, infrastructure and other critical markets Responsible & resilient supply chain A responsible, resilient and secure supply chain is essential to the markets we serve. Responsible sourcing and supplier expectations Supply chain resilience and risk management Alignment with global responsibility and compliance standards Social responsibility Our people and communities are central to our sustainability commitments. Safety, health and wellbeing across our global workforce Community engagement and investment Support for STEM education and workforce development Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) foster belonging and help amplify diverse perspectives across our global workforce. Through global philanthropy and employee volunteerism, GF supports community programs and initiatives that strengthen the regions where we live and work. Access our sustainability reports, third-party ratings and external recognitions, reflecting our ongoing commitment to transparency and responsible manufacturing.
